name: Sludge thickening
principle: Removes free water before digestion or dewatering: gravity thickeners settle sludge to 2-5% DS, DAF thickeners to 4-6% DS (better for waste activated sludge with poor settleability), rotary drum and gravity-belt thickeners to 4-8% DS with polymer; higher feed solids cut digester volume and dewatering load.

process_steps.name: Thickening
equipment: gravity thickener / DAF thickener / rotary drum thickener with polymer

costs.metric: installed capital cost, gravity thickener, by plant capacity (2-25 MGD)
costs.basis: EPA 832-F-03-022 Table 5, adjusted to the year 2000: construction plus engineering and administration of USD 199,000 at 2 MGD, 426,000 at 4 MGD, 914,000 at 8 MGD, 1,825,000 at 15 MGD, 2,504,000 at 20 MGD and 3,200,000 at 25 MGD (construction only: 162,000 to 2,610,000). The range spans plant capacity, not uncertainty at one size.

source.note: US EPA, Biosolids Technology Fact Sheet: Gravity Thickening, EPA 832-F-03-022, September 2003, Table 5 (estimated capital costs adjusted to the year 2000; underlying source U.S. EPA 1979)
